text:
olivia-recruiter: Quick sync  candidate Jules (senior product infra) verbally accepted but needs a comp-band uplift + staggered sign-on. Also asking that equity grant cliff aligns to the next company performance cycle to avoid a vesting misalignment. Proposed cash: total $300k (base 180k / target 60k / sign-on 60k). Requesting band E6 and sign-on 40% now / 30% at 3mo / 30% at 9mo. Start date proposed 2026-07-01 but candidate requests equity cliff on 2026-09-01 to match company cycle.

nina-peopleops: Thanks. We need the market comp pack, manager justification, and a note explaining why equity cliff shift is required. Also confirm manager sign-off + whether equity shift is one-off or policy-level exception.

rahul-hm: Manager sign-off here. Jules is a strategic hire and the team wants the cliff aligned to avoid giving early partial vest and then freezing during performance review blackout. Manager requests one-off exception for grant date alignment.

olivia-recruiter: Packet uploaded: gdrive.com/jules-offer + gdrive.com/jules-compdata. Written justification included. Linking candidates competing offer in DM.

paula-comp: We'll need 3 external market comps and internal parity check. Also include impact on comp band budget if we uplift to E6. If this is urgent, mark expedite.

ben-finance: Finance needs cashflow schedule and GL. If sign-on is split across quarters, show P&L timing impact. Also confirm whether sign-on will be grossed-up for relocation or taxes.

sara-legal: Equity cliff shifts require coordination with equity ops. Legal needs to confirm tax/reporting implications of moving grant effective date. If we change effective grant date after offer acceptance, include the exact language and candidate consent. Also check any shareholder plan constraints.

offer-bot: Created approval REQ-2026-0714-90. Approvers: nina-peopleops, comp-committee (chair: paula-comp), ben-finance, sara-legal, equity-ops. Status: Pending. Link: https://rbwd/approvals/REQ-2026-0714-90

nina-peopleops: Routing to comp committee. Marked as "Strategic hire  equity alignment request" and expedited. @paula-comp can you review first, please?

paula-comp: I'll pull comp committee tomorrow. Two quick asks: (1) show three comparable peer offers from market packet; (2) provide headcount/budget note: is this incremental or a backfill? Need to see if uplift consumes special comp pool.

olivia-recruiter: It's an incremental headcount (new role) and we've flagged ENG-PROD-07 budget. Market comps are in the packet. Sign-on not requesting gross-up; candidate will receive USD. Equity ops prefers grant effective date change in writing.

ben-finance: If committee approves, finance will earmark funds but needs the final schedule by EOD tomorrow to reflect in monthly forecasting.

sara-legal: We'll coordinate with equity-ops for the grant paperwork. If comp-committee approves the band uplift and equity date shift, legal will prepare consent language and confirm no plan violations.

rahul-hm: Candidate requests confirmation within 72 hours due to competing timelines. Can we aim for comp committee + legal sign-off in that window? :pray:

paula-comp: I'll escalate on the agenda and ask for an emergency quorum. Please ping me the final packet link and add "72-hr candidate hold" to the request.

nina-peopleops: Packet link: gdrive.com/jules-offer-packet (includes comps, justification, cashflow, and proposed grant language). I've added the 72-hr hold note. Will update thread when approvers act.

olivia-recruiter: Thanks team. I'll keep Jules on the 72-hr hold and let them know we're moving fast. :thumbsup:
